Run the AeroVigil server (any OS)

Every console above talks to one canonical server on port 8080. Run it on Windows, macOS or Linux — whichever machine sits closest to your turbines.

MethodCommandBest for
Python (pip)pip install -e ".[api]" && python -m src.unified_appWorkstations & dev
Dockerdocker compose up aerovigilLinux servers, NAS, cloud VMs
Kuberneteskubectl apply -k k8s/Fleet / production clusters
🛡️  AeroVigil is advisory-only by design: no actuation fields, no control commands. Put the server behind TLS (nginx / Caddy / Tailscale) before exposing it beyond your LAN.

Build from source

Binaries are published automatically to GitHub Releases when a version tag is pushed (CI matrix: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android). Until the first tag ships — or for a fully custom build — compile locally with Flutter ≥ 3.10:

# One-time setup: generate the native platform runners
cd apps/aerovigilai_flutter
flutter create --platforms=windows,macos,linux,android,ios .
flutter pub get

# Desktop builds
flutter build windows --release      # → build/windows/x64/runner/Release/
flutter build macos --release        # → build/macos/Build/Products/Release/
flutter build linux --release        # → build/linux/x64/release/bundle/

# Mobile builds
flutter build apk --release          # → build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
flutter build ipa --release          # → iOS (requires macOS + signing)
📦  Point any console at your server with --dart-define=API_BASE=http://<host>:8080 at build/run time (Android emulator: http://10.0.2.2:8080).
